purpose: Concrete binary pin for the R0 Codex CLI capability probe. 'Pin' means this experiment is tied to this exact binary, not to a version string or dist-tag.
install_method: official standalone Windows installer (irm https://chatgpt.com/codex/install.ps1 | iex); downloads from releases.openai.com
notes: First install attempt was interrupted mid-download (empty bin/); second run completed successfully and reported 'Updating Codex CLI' over the partial state.
If the binary on disk stops matching executable_sha256 (e.g. auto-update), the pin is broken and the matrix must be re-run under the new binary.
